title: Network pharmacology and experimental validation reveal mechanisms of Ilicis Cornutae Folium water extract in treating hyperuricemia.
authors: Zhou, Xiaoqi; Shi, Nan; Ding, Meihong; Hua, Liping; Shi, Senlin
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药水提物治疗高尿酸血症的网络药理学与实验验证，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Ilicis Cornutae Folium, the dried leaves of Ilex cornuta, has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine for heat-clearing, detoxification, and liver-kidney tonification. AIM OF THE STUDY: To investigate the therapeutic mechanisms of Ilicis Cornutae Folium water extract (ICFWE) on hyperuricemia (HUA) through integrated computational and pharmacological approaches. MATERIALS AND METHODS: We established hyperuricemic mouse models using an adenine/potassium oxonate combination to evaluate ICFWE's therapeutic effects. First, serum uric acid (UA) levels were measured along with renal/hepatic function markers and hepatic xanthine oxidase (XOD) activity. Next, renal histopathology was assessed through HE and Masson staining, while urate transporter expression was examined by immunohistochemistry (IHC) and real-time PCR. For chemical characterization, we employed UPLC-Q-TOF/MS analysis, while network pharmacology combined with molecular docking helped predict and validate potential targets. Finally, we analyzed apoptotic markers (BAX/Bcl-2/Caspase-3) and NF-kappaB pathway-related targets (pp65/p65/TNF-alpha/IL-1beta) by Western blot and real-time PCR. RESULTS: ICFWE (240-960 mg/kg/d) significantly reduced serum UA levels in hyperuricemic mice, improved renal function indicators, and inhibited hepatic XOD activity. Histopathological analysis showed that it decreased renal fibrosis area. At the molecular level, ICFWE upregulated the expression of renal ABCG2, OAT1, and OAT3 while downregulating GLUT9 expression. UPLC-Q-TOF/MS identified 35 chemical components, and network pharmacology screening revealed seven core active components primarily targeting the TNF, Caspase-3, Bcl-2, and NF-kappaB pathways. Molecular docking demonstrated that pedunculoside, isorhamnetin, and quercetin had strong binding affinity with Caspase-3, TNF, Bcl-2, and ABCG2. Mechanistic studies showed that ICFWE significantly downregulated BAX and cleaved caspase-3 protein expression, upregulated Bcl-2 expression, and suppressed NF-kappaB phosphorylation along with the production of downstream inflammatory factors TNF-alpha and IL-1beta. These effects were further validated in an LPS/UA-stimulated HK-2 cell model. CONCLUSION: ICFWE alleviates HUA by dual regulation of UA metabolism by inhibiting XOD production and promoting excretion and renal protection through anti-inflammatory/anti-apoptotic pathways.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：枸骨叶（Ilicis Cornutae Folium）为冬青科植物枸骨（Ilex cornuta）的干燥叶，在中医中传统用于清热、解毒及补益肝肾。研究目的：通过整合计算与药理学方法，探讨枸骨叶水提物（ICFWE）对高尿酸血症（HUA）的治疗机制。材料与方法：采用腺嘌呤/氧嗪酸钾联合诱导建立高尿酸血症小鼠模型，评估ICFWE的治疗效果。首先，测定血清尿酸（UA）水平及肾/肝功能指标和肝脏黄嘌呤氧化酶（XOD）活性。其次，通过HE和Masson染色评估肾组织病理学，并通过免疫组织化学（IHC）和实时PCR检测尿酸盐转运体表达。在化学表征方面，采用UPLC-Q-TOF/MS分析，同时结合网络药理学与分子对接预测并验证潜在靶点。最后，通过Western blot和实时PCR分析凋亡标志物（BAX/Bcl-2/Caspase-3）及NF-kappaB通路相关靶点（pp65/p65/TNF-alpha/IL-1beta）。结果：ICFWE（240-960 mg/kg/d）显著降低高尿酸血症小鼠血清UA水平，改善肾功能指标，并抑制肝脏XOD活性。组织病理学分析显示其减少肾纤维化面积。在分子水平上，ICFWE上调肾脏ABCG2、OAT1和OAT3的表达，同时下调GLUT9表达。UPLC-Q-TOF/MS鉴定出35种化学成分，网络药理学筛选揭示七个核心活性成分，主要靶向TNF、Caspase-3、Bcl-2和NF-kappaB通路。分子对接表明，长梗冬青苷（pedunculoside）、异鼠李素（isorhamnetin）和槲皮素（quercetin）与Caspase-3、TNF、Bcl-2和ABCG2具有强结合亲和力。机制研究表明，ICFWE显著下调BAX和cleaved caspase-3蛋白表达，上调Bcl-2表达，并抑制NF-kappaB磷酸化及下游炎症因子TNF-alpha和IL-1beta的产生。这些效应在LPS/UA刺激的HK-2细胞模型中进一步得到验证。结论：ICFWE通过双重调节UA代谢（抑制XOD产生并促进排泄）及通过抗炎/抗凋亡通路发挥肾脏保护作用，从而缓解HUA。
